coverage_note: Reviewed all 13 supplied pages, including tables and figure captions. Figure pixels and supplementary materials were unavailable; the finding does not depend on them.

findings.candidate_quote: the pipeline correctly identified expansions in 82% of DM1 subjects
findings.reference_quote:
All patients
with DM1 were confirmed by ONT sequencing having > 50
repeats.
findings.explanation: The 82% refers to agreement with Southern blot classification, not the proportion in whom expansions were detected. All DM1 patients had expansions detected. Although the preceding sentence correctly describes characterization of all cases, this sentence incorrectly recasts classification agreement as an expansion detection rate.
